locations.historical_name: the road from Nicomedia to Byzantium
locations.note: Not a place but a stretch of road. The Prologue has the company led bound from Nicomedia towards Byzantium, and says only that he died of his wounds and exhaustion on the way; this is the midpoint of that road, and the uncertainty is its length.
